<span class="section-kicker">Overview</span>

As Software Engineer I on the ReHAB trial, I own the software path from experiment setup through live execution. The work has to stay debuggable in the room while a study is running.

## What I did

- Built a researcher-facing control UI in C# and Python for experiment deployment and tuning.
- Ran end-to-end experimental setup and real-time hardware/software debugging under clinical constraints.
- Led the lab-wide AI integration strategy and co-authored two AI-focused grant proposals for neural decoding research.

C#, Python, Docker, GitHub
